comments.author: @Sean-j3d9w
comments.text: AroundtheEarth, when are you going to do an episode on Skid Row, or other dangerous places in America?

replies.author: @TravelToFacts
replies.text: @Sean-j3d9w If you had to prioritize one solution—creating jobs or providing addiction recovery support—which one do you think would be more effective in bringing about change in Skid Row?

replies.author: @Sean-j3d9w
replies.text: @TravelToFacts I cannot name one but rather two root causes.  Firstly, the people are impoverished and there are no employment opportunities.  Secondly, the are is saturated with cheap yet dangerous drugs that the people get hooked on.

replies.author: @TravelToFacts
replies.text: @Sean-j3d9w You have highlighted serious issues that make Skid Row such a challenging place. In your view, what is the root cause that must be addressed first to break this vicious cycle?

replies.author: @Sean-j3d9w
replies.text: @TravelToFacts Death, Lawlessness, Drugs, Gangs -- All factors in what makes Skid Row and places similar to it an urban hell.

replies.author: @TravelToFacts
replies.text: 👏 Cảm ơn bạn đã đề xuất một chủ đề hấp dẫn! 🇺🇸 Skid Row chắc chắn có nhiều câu chuyện đời thực đáng được khám phá. Theo bạn, điều gì khiến Skid Row trở thành nơi mà khán giả nên tìm hiểu đầu tiên? 👀

replies.author: @AroundTheEarth.Official
replies.text: Great minds think alike! 👀 We’re working on some intense, raw content showing sides of the world many people rarely see. Skid Row is a heavy topic, but a very real one. Which other dangerous spots or hidden sides of the US are you curious about? Let me know! 👀👇
